clusters.mechanism: explainStatus ignores the run's persisted merged=true flag (stripped by the schema), so merged PRs are reported as unknown or needing review instead of Landed.

Digest seeds review candidates only from PR-opened, round-delivered and approval events, so an unread PR event (e.g. pr.ci_passed) that follows a stale approval after acknowledgment never triggers a review check.
Digest's awaiting-review predicate ignores review.rounds, so PRs with queued or running changes rounds are still listed as awaiting review.
When loadPrivateStrings throws, limitless_status returns a stripped result without run id, state or nextAction.
The blocked-land branch in status is evaluated before the resolved or closed-PR checks, so historical land blocks override closed or resolved states.
Digest treats an approved PR with an unobserved head (undefined headRefOid) as awaiting review, disagreeing with status's 'PR state unknown'.
Digest rows quote full untrusted title and summary text with no per-line length cap, so output size is unbounded despite the 20-line limit.
Digest performs per-item run and land lookups sequentially without per-item error handling, so one failure aborts the whole digest.
The source diff is about twice the requested line budget.
A newly added assertion in test/mcp-proxy.test.ts is not formatted per Biome, so bun run check fails at lint.
A matching approval recorded after round creation hides an active (running or waiting) review round in status.
The Codex skill is a copy of the Claude skill and instructs use of the 'claude' feed consumer, so the two agents share one cursor.
getRunDetail queries the latest approval twice, which adds a query and risks inconsistent rows.
MCP review verdicts drop the reviewer field, so submitReview defaults it to 'human' and AI approvals are misattributed.
